name: RuntimeKinds
description: Heap kinds and root kinds: finalizable objects (half suppressed), POH and LOH arrays, pinned handles, a frozen literal, and a parked thread holding a local and an interior pointer.
notes: FinalizableResource: N instances, half registered for finalization (the others called GC.SuppressFinalize). PinnedPoint[]: N pinned GC handles. RuntimeFixtures.s_literal: a string literal in the frozen heap. A parked thread holds one StackRootedObject in a local and an InteriorElement[] only through a ref to its element 3.
